mainEntity.name: How much does a primary-residence tiny home typically cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of a primary-residence tiny home can range widely depending on size, materials, finishes, and custom features. Typically, a professionally built tiny home shell might start around $60,000 to $80,000, while a fully furnished and ready-to-live-in model can range from $100,000 to $180,000 or more. This usually includes construction but excludes land acquisition, site preparation, utility connections, and permits, which add significant costs. Custom designs and high-end amenities will increase the overall investment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs for primary tiny homes vary based on size and features, typically ranging from $100,000 to $180,000 for a ready-to-live model, excluding land and site work.
